title: Đề luyện Viết VSTEP — Review HVNH HN 18/8/2026

questions.content:
writing — Task 1

Your friend Jo wants to be selected for the school hockey team but is worried about not being good enough, and has written to ask for your advice. Write a letter to Jo. In your letter, you should: 1. tell Jo what you think about trying out for the team despite the worry 2. reply to Jo's invitation to train together and suggest how to prepare 3. give advice about joining a fitness programme and what food to eat for training

writing — Task 2

You should spend about 60 minutes on this task. People often disagree about what makes an athlete successful. Some believe that natural ability is the most important factor, while others argue that hard work and training matter more. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write an essay of at least 250 words.
